variants.name: #[inline(always)] forced inlining
variants.implementation_notes: Overrides the budget, for the one function the profile shows as call-overhead-bound. Pair it with #[cold] #[inline(never)] on the error path so the cold body stays out of the hot function entirely - a pairing that is as much about layout as inlining.
variants.code_sketch:
#[inline(always)] fn hot_step(x: i32) -> i32 { if x < 0 { 0 } else { x } }
#[cold] #[inline(never)] fn bail(msg: &str) -> ! { panic!("{msg}") }
pitfalls: Code size multiplies; can exceed the i-cache.
